text: Doors are deleting your memory. And it gets worse.
You march to the kitchen for one thing. One! You step through the door... gone.
Meet Gary, the tiny intern in your brain. He holds your thought on a sticky note.
Scientists tested it. People forget more walking through a door than walking the same distance with no door.
Now add stress. Ten tabs open, phone in your hand, looking for your phone. Gary is on fire.
Here's the twist. You're not broken. Later research found doors mostly trip you up when your head is already full.
So do one thing at a time, and Gary keeps the note.
Anyway. Why did you walk in here?
